messages.content: Please check whether Apple AirPods Pro 2 are in stock in the audio category and show me the stock details for product_id p_apple_airpods, quantity 1. Then look up trending audio alternatives and choose one recommendation for 1 item, and reserve that selected alternative for me and confirm the order. After that, generate an invoice for invoice_items [{product_id: p_apple_airpods, quantity: 1}] using the SAVE15 coupon_code, send it to user@example.com, and use payment_gateway stripe with payment_method card_visa. Also, for user_id user_123 with priority medium and tags shopping, iot, invoice, check the living_room area for device_type lock devices, diagnose all_issues, then set lock_id lock_main to lock using pin_code 2026. Finally, send me an app alert on channel app with a document titled “Purchase and Home Security Audit” about that action.
